infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: You're On uses the camera to scan faces you choose to challenge, to enroll your own face if you opt in, and to record the attempt the AI judge rules on.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: You're On uses the microphone so you can talk to the AI judge while setting up a bet and during a hearing.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: You're On listens for "Jarvis" on this device so you can say your challenge out loud instead of typing it.
